newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal LePage buys Winnipeg real estate co.
newsitem.headline: Royal LePage buys Winnipeg real estate co.

text.p: Royal LePage Real Estate Services Ltd said on Tuesday it purchased closely held DELBRO Real Estate of Winnipeg for an undisclosed sum.

Royal LePage said the acquisition of DELBRO, Manitoba's largest independent real estate company, makes Royal LePage one of the largest residental brokerage companies in the province with a combined force of more than 200 sales representatives.

"The DELBRO acquisition is a key element in our long term strategic plan to acquire companies that have both a history of success and a promising future," said Simon Dean, president, residential, for Royal LePage.
While it was determined that DELBRO will assume the Royal LePage name, it was also confirmed that most present positions at the company will be maintained, Royal LePage said.
